metaDescription: Order custom baseball workwear for your team or staff. Durable, breathable fabrics with full decoration options. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Custom baseball workwear combines the classic diamond-style jersey with durable fabrics built for long days on the field or job site. Choose moisture-wicking polyester or cotton blends in team colors, with full front and back decoration for logos, names, and numbers. The Port Authority® Enhanced Visibility Cap adds safety with reflective trim, making these uniforms practical for construction crews, grounds crews, or tournament staff who need visibility and comfort.
heroAltText: Baseball workwear jersey with embroidered logo and reflective cap for team uniforms
